answer: The ledge of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The kernel is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the sparrow. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
